newsitem.title: JAPAN: Foreigners yen bond buying at record high in April.
newsitem.headline: Foreigners yen bond buying at record high in April.

text.p: Foreign investors' net purchases of yen bonds in April totalled a record high 5.1777 trillion yen, the Japan Securities Dealers' Association (JSDA) said on Tuesday.
The previous record high was 3.1288 trillion yen in October 1996.
Foreigners were the biggest yen bond buyers in April, the JSDA said.
The figures include Japanese government bonds, notes and Treasury bills, corporate bonds and bank debentures, the JSDA said.
